content: Valt.UI registers services as singletons or transients in src/Valt.UI/Extensions.cs (e.g., ITransactionSelectionService, IAutoSatRefreshService, IModalFactory). Services live in src/Valt.UI/Services/ with interface + implementation pairs. Valt.App uses Scrutor auto-registration for command/query handlers via AddApplication(). UI services follow a simple interface/class pattern with constructor DI.
